---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
author: "Eliza"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/seda_2025.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
score_change <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023)) |>
  group_by(district_id, district_name, state) |>
  summarise(
    score_2015 = max(case_when(year == 2015 ~ rla_score)),
    score_2023 = max(case_when(year == 2023 ~ rla_score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(score_2015), !is.na(score_2023)) |>
  mutate(score_change = score_2023 - score_2015) |>
  collect()
state_change <- tbl(con, "state_scores") |>
  filter(year %in% c(2015, 2023)) |>
  group_by(stateabb, state_name) |>
  summarise(
    score_2015 = max(case_when(year == 2015 ~ rla_score)),
    score_2023 = max(case_when(year == 2023 ~ rla_score)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(score_2015), !is.na(score_2023)) |>
  mutate(score_change = score_2023 - score_2015) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
score_change |>
  mutate(
    rla_change = score_change,
    change_direction = if_else(rla_change > 0, "Positive", "Negative or zero")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rla_change, fill = change_direction)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of District Reading Score Changes",
    subtitle = paste("Districts with data in both years:", nrow(score_change)),
    caption = "Change is the 2023 score minus the 2015 score.",
    x = "Reading score change",
    y = "Number of districts",
    fill = "Change"
  )
```

```{r}
state_change |>
  mutate(
    state_name = fct_reorder(state_name, score_2023),
    change_direction = if_else(score_change > 0, "Improved", "Declined")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(y = state_name)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = score_2015, xend = score_2023, yend = state_name, color = change_direction),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "inches"))
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = score_2015), color = "gray") +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Score Changes, 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = "States are ordered by their 2023 reading score; gray dots mark 2015",
    caption = "Arrows point from 2015 to 2023. Positive change indicates improvement.",
    x = "Reading score",
    y = NULL,
    color = "Direction"
  )
```
